prompt:
Repaint this cannon as a clean reference picture for a 3D modeller. Keep exactly the same design, the same parts, the same proportions and the same colours: a short dark iron swivel gun with a muzzle ring and a round knob at the breech, held in an iron yoke on a thick round wooden post, the post standing on a round riveted iron foot plate.

Three-quarter view from the front left and a little from above, the whole object in frame and centred, filling about 70 percent of the picture. Plain flat light grey background. No ground, no floor, no cast shadow. Soft even light from the front. Crisp clean outlines and smooth painted surfaces without brush texture. Only this one object, no text, no other objects.
label: cannon b clean view
